options.content: **Data since ${go_live}.** There is no backfill: charts start empty at go-live and fill as the collector runs. All times are UTC.

Definitions are copied from the v1 Metabase cards 175 and 183 (exported 08-10-2026). Months are UTC calendar months. 'Pilots with Y' uses the v1 name rule (the fourth character from the end of the pilot's name is 'Y'). Pilots are those who filed a flight plan (the v3 flight gate). Pilot hours are time online per flight, from the first to the last stored position inside the Australian airspace polygon. There is no backfill, so the charts start at go-live.

panels.title: Australian-based pilots and ATC online each month
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 175 (v1 drew a bar chart). Per UTC month: distinct pilots whose name ends in a Y airport (v1 rule), all distinct pilots, and distinct controllers. Pilots are counted in the month of the session logon, controllers in the month the session started. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
WITH flight_summaries AS (
  -- v3 stand-in for the v1 table (see docs/t15_notes/a_pilots_people.md): one row per flight
  SELECT cid, name, logon_time,
         end_time AS completion_time,
         airborne_minutes AS total_enroute_time_minutes,
         duration_minutes AS time_online_minutes
  FROM flight
),
pilot_stats AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cid) FILTER (WHERE LENGTH(name) >= 4 AND SUBSTRING(name FROM LENGTH(name) - 3 FOR 1) = 'Y') as unique_pilots_with_Y,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as total_unique_pilots
    FROM flight_summaries
    WHERE logon_time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
),
atc_stats AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as total_unique_atc
    FROM controller_summaries
    WHERE session_start_time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(p.month, a.month) as month,
    COALESCE(p.unique_pilots_with_Y, 0) as unique_pilots_with_Y,
    COALESCE(p.total_unique_pilots, 0) as total_unique_pilots,
    COALESCE(a.total_unique_atc, 0) as total_unique_atc
FROM pilot_stats p
FULL OUTER JOIN atc_stats a ON p.month = a.month
ORDER BY month

panels.title: Pilot hours per month (names with Y)
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 183. Hours online (sum of flight time online) per UTC month of flight completion, for pilots with a Y-suffixed name, from 1 September of the current year (v1 hard-coded this: from January to August the chart is empty). Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
WITH flight_summaries AS (
  -- v3 stand-in for the v1 table (see docs/t15_notes/a_pilots_people.md): one row per flight
  SELECT cid, name, logon_time,
         end_time AS completion_time,
         airborne_minutes AS total_enroute_time_minutes,
         duration_minutes AS time_online_minutes
  FROM flight
)
SELECT
  to_char(date_trunc('month', completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  ROUND(SUM(time_online_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS total_hours
FROM flight_summaries
WHERE
  name IS NOT NULL
  AND length(name) >= 4
  AND SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) = 'Y'
  AND completion_time >= (date_trunc('year', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + interval '8 months') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'  -- 1 September (UTC) of the current year
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
